packageRules.description: A kopje update upgrades the instance when it is merged: one pull request per version, never merged automatically. Read the release notes and docs/upgrade.md first.
prBodyNotes: Merging this deploys the new Kopje version, which may upgrade the Store's schema. Before merging, read the release notes and https://github.com/shuymn/kopje/blob/main/packages/kopje/docs/upgrade.md.
